examples.question_text:
A savings account starts with $\$0$. Equal deposits of $\$800$ are made at the end of each year, after interest is added. The annual interest rate is fixed.

Use Year $2$ to find the annual interest rate, then complete the table for Years $3$ and $4$. Calculate the total interest earned over the four years.

All balances and interest amounts are in dollars.

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Year}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Deposit}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&0&0&800&800\\2&800&40&800&1640\\3&1640&\cdots&800&\cdots\\4&\cdots&\cdots&800&\cdots\\\hline\end{array}$
examples.solution_text:
Equal annual deposits make this a savings annuity. Interest is calculated on the opening balance before the deposit is added.

$\begin{align*}r&=\frac{40}{800}\\&=0.05=5\%\end{align*}$

For Year $3$:

$\begin{align*}I_3&=1640\times0.05\\&=\$82\\\text{Closing}_3&=1640+82+800\\&=\$2522\end{align*}$

The closing balance becomes the next year's opening balance.

$\begin{align*}I_4&=2522\times0.05\\&=\$126.10\\\text{Closing}_4&=2522+126.10+800\\&=\$3448.10\end{align*}$

The completed table, in dollars, is:

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Year}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Deposit}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&0&0&800&800\\2&800&40&800&1640\\3&1640&82&800&2522\\4&2522&126.10&800&3448.10\\\hline\end{array}$

$\begin{align*}\text{Total deposits}&=4\times800\\&=\$3200\\\text{Total interest}&=3448.10-3200\\&=\$248.10\end{align*}$

examples.question_text:
A reducing-balance loan starts at $\$6000$. Interest is charged at $12\%$ p.a. compounded monthly. Repayments of $\$500$ are made at the end of each month, after interest is charged.

Complete the table for the first three months and calculate the total interest charged. Give monetary answers to the nearest cent, retaining full precision until rounding each requested result.

All amounts in the table are in dollars.

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Month}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Repayment}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&6000&\cdots&500&\cdots\\2&\cdots&\cdots&500&\cdots\\3&\cdots&\cdots&500&\cdots\\\hline\end{array}$
examples.solution_text:
The monthly interest rate is $12\%\div12=1\%$. Add interest to the opening balance, then subtract the repayment.

$\begin{align*}I_1&=6000\times0.01=60\\\text{Closing}_1&=6000+60-500=5560\\I_2&=5560\times0.01=55.60\\\text{Closing}_2&=5560+55.60-500=5115.60\\I_3&=5115.60\times0.01=51.156\\\text{Closing}_3&=5115.60+51.156-500=4666.756\end{align*}$

The completed table, in dollars, is:

$\begin{array}{|c|r|r|r|r|}\hline \text{Month}&\text{Opening}&\text{Interest}&\text{Repayment}&\text{Closing}\\\hline 1&6000.00&60.00&500.00&5560.00\\2&5560.00&55.60&500.00&5115.60\\3&5115.60&51.16&500.00&4666.76\\\hline\end{array}$

Repayments cover both the reduction in principal and the interest charged.

$\begin{align*}\text{Principal reduction}&=6000-4666.756\\&=1333.244\\\text{Total repayments}&=3\times500=1500\\\text{Total interest}&=1500-1333.244\\&=166.756\\&\approx\$166.76\end{align*}$

examples.question_text:
Maya starts a savings account with no initial investment. She deposits $\$900$ at the end of each half-year. Interest is paid at $4\%$ p.a. compounded half-yearly.

Write a recurrence relation, including the starting value, and determine the balance after four deposits to the nearest cent.
examples.solution_text:
The half-yearly interest rate is $4\%\div2=2\%$. Let $V_n$ be the balance immediately after the $n$th deposit.

$V_0=0,\qquad V_n=V_{n-1}(1.02)+900$.

Apply the relation to each previous balance, retaining full precision.

$\begin{align*}V_1&=0(1.02)+900\\&=900\\V_2&=900(1.02)+900\\&=1818\\V_3&=1818(1.02)+900\\&=2754.36\\V_4&=2754.36(1.02)+900\\&=3709.4472\\&\approx\$3709.45\end{align*}$

examples.question_text:
A loan is modelled by $V_n=V_{n-1}(1.02)-80$, where $V_0=5000$ and $V_n$ is the balance immediately after the $n$th monthly repayment.

Find the balance after three repayments, to the nearest cent, and explain why the debt increases despite regular repayments.
examples.solution_text:
Use the previous balance to calculate each new balance.

$\begin{align*}V_1&=5000(1.02)-80\\&=5020\\V_2&=5020(1.02)-80\\&=5040.40\\V_3&=5040.40(1.02)-80\\&=5061.208\\&\approx\$5061.21\end{align*}$

The first month's interest is $5000\times0.02=\$100$. The $\$80$ repayment is less than the interest charged, so the debt increases. As the balance grows, the monthly interest also increases.

examples.derivation: Independently calculated r = 40/800 = 0.05. Year 3 interest is 82 and closing balance is 2522. Year 4 interest is 126.10 and closing balance is 3448.10. Total interest is 3448.10 − 4×800 = 248.10, also equal to 0 + 40 + 82 + 126.10. The supplied savings tables, image7 rate-inference task and interest calculation support the mapped methods.

Independently calculated monthly rate 0.12/12 = 0.01. Successive interest amounts are 60, 55.60 and 51.156; closing balances are 5560, 5115.60 and 4666.756. Total interest is 1500 − (6000 − 4666.756) = 166.756, rounding to $166.76. Summing the unrounded interest amounts gives the same result. The loan-table tasks and total-repayment-minus-principal method support this adaptation.

Independently calculated half-yearly rate 0.04/2 = 0.02. With V0 = 0 and Vn = 1.02V(n−1) + 900, successive balances are 900, 1818, 2754.36 and 3709.4472. The final balance rounds to $3709.45. The supplied savings investigation and half-yearly savings task support the recurrence and payment timing.

Independently evaluated the supplied recurrence to obtain 5020, 5040.40 and 5061.208, giving $5061.21 after three repayments. Initial interest is 5000×0.02 = $100, exceeding the $80 repayment. Subsequent interest increases with the growing balance. The loan worked example and increasing-loan explanation task support both mapped methods.
